quarterly_data.quarter: Montage Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report, products and position: DDR5 RCD shipments rose sharply in 2025; third-sub-generation RCDs shipped at scale and in H2 2025 their sales revenue exceeded the second sub-generation's, and the fourth sub-generation (7200MT/s) reached mass production in October 2025. The second-generation MRCD/MDB (12800MT/s, 45% above the first generation, launched January 2025) saw shipments rise significantly from Q4 2025; the company calls itself one of only two suppliers of first-generation MRCD/MDB. It is one of two main suppliers of PCIe 5.0 Retimers; it sampled its PCIe 6.x/CXL 3.x Retimer (64GT/s, 43dB link budget, in-house PAM4 SerDes) in January 2025 and released a PCIe 6.x/CXL 3.x AEC solution in January 2026. Its CXL 3.1 MXC chip (launched September 2025) is sampling to major customers, and more server makers launched CXL memory-expansion solutions based on its MXC. Citing Frost & Sullivan data, the company ranked first in the 2024 memory-interconnect chip market with a 36.8% share (top three 93.4%) and second in PCIe Retimers with 10.9% (top two 96.9%).
quarterly_data.figure: 4th sub-gen DDR5 RCD mass production Oct 2025; memory-interconnect share 36.8% (2024, #1); PCIe Retimer share 10.9% (#2)

quarterly_data.quarter: Montage Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report, R&D: R&D expense RMB 915,030,216.00, up 19.85%, 16.77% of revenue (none capitalised); 583 R&D staff, 74.36% of headcount. 2025 results: fourth-sub-generation DDR5 RCD in mass production; mass-production versions of the fifth-sub-generation RCD and second-generation MRCD/MDB completed; PCIe 6.x/CXL 3.x Retimer mass-production version in development and applied to the AEC solution; engineering R&D under way on the PCIe 7.0 Retimer and PCIe Switch; CXL 2.0 MXC mass-production version and CXL 3.x MXC engineering design completed; first clock-buffer and spread-spectrum oscillator chips completed engineering R&D; sixth-generation Jintide performance-core CPU released (up to 86 cores, 172 threads, 336MB L3 cache, 8-channel DDR5 supporting 6400MT/s RDIMM or 8000MT/s MRDIMM, 88 PCIe 5.0 lanes). It is developing 128GT/s SerDes for the PCIe 7.0 Retimer and a high-speed Ethernet PHY Retimer. Construction in progress: the Lingang R&D centre project in Shanghai (budget RMB 797,460,000.00) stood at RMB 587,690,019.31, 73.70% of budget, under construction.

quarterly_data.quarter: Montage Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report, 2026 business plan (company targets): raise shipments of third- and fourth-sub-generation DDR5 RCDs and capture MRCD/MDB penetration; bring new-generation PCIe Retimer and CXL MXC chips into more customers' supply chains to grow revenue; complete engineering R&D of the sixth-sub-generation DDR5 RCD and third-generation MRCD/MDB and start engineering R&D of first-generation DDR6 memory-interconnect products; complete mass-production versions of the PCIe 6.x/CXL 3.x Retimer and CXL 3.x MXC; tape out engineering samples of the PCIe 7.0 Retimer, PCIe Switch and high-speed Ethernet PHY Retimer; and complete mass-production versions of the first and second batches of clock-buffer chips. Strategy: build an Ethernet and optical-interconnect product line step by step through in-house development, cooperation and / or investment, and pursue investment and M&A in interconnect segments.

quarterly_data.quarter: Montage Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report, company outlook: a typical AI server usually carries more than 20 DDR5 memory modules; MRDIMM is expected to have large demand in cloud and AI and, as the technology and ecosystem mature, may replace RDIMM as the preferred AI-server main memory, driving a surge in MRCD/MDB demand. DDR5 is expected to have six sub-generations with the iteration cycle shortened to 12-18 months (about 18-24 months per DDR4 sub-generation). A typical 8-GPU AI server needs 8 to 16 PCIe Retimers (24 in some domestic designs) and 2 to 4 PCIe Switches. Major cloud providers are deploying CXL memory pools in new server clusters, each pool typically with 16-32 CXL MXC chips and 2-4 CXL Switch chips; the company expects the CXL pooling and sharing ecosystem to mature further in the next one to two years.
quarterly_data.figure: MRDIMM may replace RDIMM in AI servers; 8 to 16 PCIe Retimers per 8-GPU server; 16-32 MXC per CXL memory pool
